Grimes County is seated at Anderson, though Navasota is the county's largest town and commercial hub, straddling Highway 6 between Bryan-College Station and Houston. Cattle ranching, hay and timber dominate the rural economy, with commuter spillover from the Bryan-College Station area shaping demand along the county's southern edge.
